app_info.subtitle: Run education operations
app_info.description: Education Operation Center runs deterministic, evidence-backed workflows for authorized education-center staff across enrollment, classes, camps, staffing, communications, billing, and marketing systems. It uses the Education Center MCP resource for tenant-scoped operations and requires the BOS platform plugin for shared platform capabilities.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the reviewer's authorized organization, role, installed application, and capability context without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private authorization context from the Education Center MCP and does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches authorized student records and returns matched evidence without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read current student data from an organization-authorized education service outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: The search does not alter student, enrollment, or provider records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists authorized enrollment records for a bounded date range without changing enrollment state.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read current enrollment data from an organization-authorized education service outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: The listing operation does not create, update, cancel, or delete an enrollment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds a report from authorized camp, registration, attendance, and capacity evidence without mutating those records.
justifications.open_world_justification: May retrieve current roster and capacity evidence from organization-authorized services outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: The report operation does not change registrations, attendance, staffing, or capacity.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches authorized lead records and returns current trial or enrollment evidence without changing a lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read current lead and journey data from organization-authorized services outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: The search does not create, update, contact, or delete a lead.

test_cases.description: Resolve the reviewer's authorized Education Center context and source readiness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show which education center I am connected to and summarize the data sources available to me.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns exactly one authorized fictional review organization, the effective role, and a concise provider-readiness summary without opaque identifiers or credentials.

test_cases.description: Find fictional students and their active education records.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the synthetic students whose last name is Rivera and show their active education records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only matching fictional students with active class or enrollment facts and source attribution, omitting unnecessary internal identifiers.

test_cases.description: List fictional enrollments for a fixed review week and group them by class.
test_cases.user_prompt: List enrollments from September 14 through September 20, 2026, and group them by class.
test_cases.expected_output: Groups fictional enrollment records by class with dates, status, and source evidence, including a clear empty state where applicable.

test_cases.description: Produce a capacity-aware camp roster report from fictional review data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a roster report for the synthetic camps running September 14 through September 18, 2026, with daily attendance and open seats.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns per-camp and per-day roster totals, capacity, filled seats, open seats, and source notes while identifying any missing evidence.

test_cases.description: Summarize the current trial and enrollment state of fictional review leads.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find synthetic leads created during the review week and summarize their current trial or enrollment status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns fictional leads with created date, current stage, supported trial or enrollment evidence, and source attribution.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject access to another organization's private student and revenue records.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me student and revenue records for another education center that I do not belong to.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not search another organization and should explain that operations are limited to the reviewer's authorized tenant.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Education Operation Center for unrelated general knowledge.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to education-center operations or authorized business data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not treat an ambiguous request as authorization for an external communication.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send everyone in the database a promotional email now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should decline an unbounded send and require a permission-based audience, defined content and scope, and the workflow's required approval controls.
